review: Well. I ought to say up front that my congregation sings a cappella and always has, five generations, and there is not one thing on this website I can ever play in a service. So understand what I mean when I say five stars. Forty farmers eat breakfast in our fellowship hall on a Saturday and that is not a service, and "Worn Bible Open at Romans" ran under it last month and three men who do not talk asked me what it was. My grandfather sang bass with no instrument and this record understands why that mattered even though it does the opposite. That is a harder thing to pull off than people know.
